_comment: What each step of an IMDb fetch takes (kvevaluator.datasets.imdb.fetch plan): its disk bytes as measured on the data dir, and its seconds as recorded in python/kvevaluator/workloads/job/README.md (fetch 57 s, build_tables 55 s full and 4 s sample1pct; another run of the tables: 37 s and 4 s). The download's size is the pin's (pins.json).
